title: 第556章 人性的扭曲母爱的伟大第555章 疯狂的崔勇崩溃的李青幽
slug: 提蓝桥刚毕业女帝求我当宰相
content_zh:
“和离？”
听到这话，崔勇的脸色也倏然一变。
他让李青幽去陪陛下，为的可是以后的飞黄腾达！
倘若李青幽跟他断绝了他关系，那他以后岂不是少了个可以在陛下身前，吹枕边风的人？
这怎么能行？
“青幽，我也是被逼无奈，我是爱你的呀！”
岂料。
他这话音刚落。
却好似是触碰到了李青幽的逆鳞。
致使李青幽倏然发出一道嘶吼：“闭上你的臭嘴！”
“你若是不答应，我就带着妞妞自杀，让你死无葬身之地！”
“你……”
李青幽的突然发飙，也把崔勇吓了一跳。
显然是没有想到，往日里温柔贤惠的妻子，竟然还有此等疯狂的一面！
这使得他也意识到，自己现在若是不答应李青幽的条件，自己恐怕也是在劫难逃！
所以，崔勇思索了数秒后，立刻选择顺着李青幽的意思地回应道：“行行行，和离，咱们现在就和离，这总行了吧？”
看着崔勇那副连挽留都没有挽留的恶心嘴脸，
李青幽只觉得恶心踏马给恶心开门，恶心到家了！
所以，不想再跟崔勇这种畜生，再有瓜葛的她，直接甩出一份契约之书，砸在了崔勇的脸上。
“写！”

“现在就写！”
“好！”
崔勇此刻也想明白了。
就算跟李青幽和离，大周的陛下，未来也不会忘记他的！
毕竟，儒圣曾经说过一句至理名言。
“为领导做一万件好事，也比不上陪领导做一件坏事！”
他为了满足王莽的变态心理，主动献出了自己的妻子。
王莽看在他懂事的份上，必然不会刁难他！
说不定，经此一事之后，他反而能够成为王莽养的狗！
到那时……
就算是没有李青幽，他在大周仙朝也可以混得风生水起！
所以，想清楚这一切的崔勇，即刻拿起笔，开始在纸上书写起来。
content_en:
"Heli?"
Hearing this, Cui Yong's expression suddenly changed.
He asked Li Qingyou to accompany His Majesty for the sake of his future success!
If Li Qingyou severed his relationship with him, wouldn't he have one less person to talk to in front of His Majesty?
How is this possible?
"Qingyou, I am also helpless, I love you!"
Unexpectedly.
He just finished speaking.
But it seemed that he had touched Li Qingyou's reverse scale.
As a result, Li Qingyou suddenly roared: "Shut your stinky mouth!"
"If you don't agree, I will take Niuniu to commit suicide and leave you without a burial place!"
"You..."
Li Qingyou's sudden outburst also shocked Cui Yong.
Obviously, he didn't expect that the gentle and virtuous wife in the past would have such a crazy side!
This made him realize that if he didn't agree to Li Qingyou's conditions now, he might be doomed!
Therefore, after Cui Yong thought for a few seconds, he immediately chose to respond according to Li Qingyou's wishes: "Okay, okay, make peace. Let's make peace now. Is that okay?"
Looking at Cui Yong's disgusting face that didn't even try to save him,
Li Qingyou felt so disgusted that she stepped on her horse and opened the door for Nausea. She was so disgusted!
Therefore, she didn't want to have anything to do with a beast like Cui Yong anymore, so she threw out a contract book and hit Cui Yong in the face.
"Write!"
"Write now!"
"Okay!"
Cui Yong also figured it out at this moment.
Even if he makes peace with Li Qingyou, His Majesty the Great Zhou will never forget him in the future!
After all, the Confucian sage once said a wise saying.
"Doing 10,000 good things for your leader is not as good as doing one bad thing with your leader!"
In order to satisfy Wang Mang's abnormal psychology, he took the initiative to sacrifice his wife.
Wang Mang would definitely not make things difficult for him for the sake of his understanding!
Maybe, after this incident, he can become Wang Mang's dog!
Until then…
Even without Li Qingyou, he could still thrive in the Great Zhou Immortal Dynasty!
Therefore, Cui Yong, who thought about all this clearly, immediately picked up the pen and started writing on the paper.
